mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG ( BUYER, BS_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, MAKER_CODE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, ORIGIN_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, AGENT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_MEASURE, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQ_USER_TEL_NO, BEFORE_GR_DATE, AGENT_CODE, AGENT_NAME, AGENT_USER_ID, AGENT_USER_NAME, AGENT_TEL_NO, KEP_USER_ID, KEP_USER_NAME, REMARK, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, PROCESS_TYPE, WAREHOUSE_CODE, DELY_TO_LOCATION, ADD_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{BUYER_CODE}, #{BS_NO}, #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{DESCRIPTION}, #{SPECIFICATION}, #{MAKER_CODE}, #{MAKER_NAME}, #{ORIGIN_CODE}, #{ORIGIN_NAME}, #{UNIT_PRICE}, #{AGENT_PRICE}, #{ITEM_QTY}, #{UNIT_MEASURE}, #{REQ_USER_ID}, #{REQ_USER_NAME}, #{REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE}, #{REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME}, #{REQ_USER_TEL_NO}, #{BEFORE_GR_DATE}, #{AGENT_CODE}, #{AGENT_NAME}, #{AGENT_USER_ID}, #{AGENT_USER_NAME}, #{AGENT_TEL_NO}, #{KEP_USER_ID}, #{KEP_USER_NAME}, #{REMARK}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{PROCESS_TYPE}, #{WAREHOUSE_CODE}, #{DELY_TO_LOCATION}, #{st_user_id} )

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A SET A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, -- 1 A.CONTRACT_NO = #{CONTRACT_NO}, -- 2 A.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, -- 3 A.DESCRIPTION = #{DESCRIPTION}, -- 4 A.SPECIFICATION = #{SPECIFICATION}, -- 5 A.MAKER_CODE = #{MAKER_CODE}, -- 6 A.MAKER_NAME = #{MAKER_NAME}, -- 7 A.ORIGIN_CODE = #{ORIGIN_CODE}, -- 8 A.ORIGIN_NAME = #{ORIGIN_NAME}, -- 9 A.UNIT_PRICE = #{UNIT_PRICE}, -- 10 A.AGENT_PRICE = #{AGENT_PRICE}, -- 11 A.ITEM_QTY = #{ITEM_QTY}, -- 12 A.UNIT_MEASURE = #{UNIT_MEASURE}, -- 13 A.REQ_USER_ID = #{REQ_USER_ID}, -- 14 A.REQ_USER_NAME = #{REQ_USER_NAME}, -- 15 A.REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE = #{REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE}, -- 16 A.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME = #{REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME}, -- 17 A.REQ_USER_TEL_NO = #{REQ_USER_TEL_NO}, -- 18 A.BEFORE_GR_DATE = #{BEFORE_GR_DATE}, -- 19 A.AGENT_CODE = #{AGENT_CODE}, -- 20 A.AGENT_NAME = #{AGENT_NAME}, -- 21 A.AGENT_USER_ID = #{AGENT_USER_ID}, -- 22 A.AGENT_USER_NAME = #{AGENT_USER_NAME}, -- 23 A.AGENT_TEL_NO = #{AGENT_TEL_NO}, -- 24 A.KEP_USER_ID = #{KEP_USER_ID}, -- 25 A.KEP_USER_NAME = #{KEP_USER_NAME}, -- 26 A.REMARK = #{REMARK}, -- 27 A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), A.PROCESS_TYPE = #{PROCESS_TYPE} , -- 28 A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE} , -- 29 A.DELY_TO_LOCATION = #{DELY_TO_LOCATION} -- 30 WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} -- 31 AND A.BS_NO = #{BS_NO} -- 32

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET STATUS = 'F', PO_NO = PO_NO || #{st_po_no}, CLOSE_ITEM_QTY = CLOSE_ITEM_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{st_close_item_qty}), CHANGE_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND BS_NO=#{st_bs_no}

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET STATUS = 'P', PO_NO = PO_NO || #{st_po_no}, CLOSE_ITEM_QTY = CLOSE_ITEM_QTY + TO_NUMBER(#{st_close_item_qty}), CHANGE_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BS_NO = #{st_bs_no}

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET STATUS = 'C', PO_NO = NULL, CLOSE_ITEM_QTY = 0, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BS_NO = #{st_bs_no}

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET STATUS = 'C', PO_NO = NULL, CLOSE_ITEM_QTY = 0, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND BS_NO = #{BS_NO}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(NVL(A.ITEM_QTY, 0)) - ( SUM(NVL(B.INV_QTY, 0))) FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO(+) AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND B.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND B.STATUS(+) ^='D' GROUP BY A.BUYER
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT ( INV_NO, INV_SEQ, BUYER, BS_NO, SELLER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, INV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_AMT, INVOICE_DATE, PURCHASER_ID, PURCHASER_DEPT, DELY_TO_LOCATION ) SELECT #{INV_NO}, TO_CHAR( #{INV_SEQ},'FM000000'), D.BUYER, D.BS_NO, 'KRKORE0001' SELLER, 'C', '', '', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, D.ITEM_QTY, DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',D.AGENT_PRICE, D.UNIT_PRICE) UNIT_PRICE, TRUNC((DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',D.AGENT_PRICE, D.UNIT_PRICE) * D.ITEM_QTY )), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YY/MM/DD'), #{REQ_USER_ID}, #{REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE}, DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', (SELECT MAX(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = D.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND TYPE = 'C012'),D.DELY_TO_LOCATION) DELY_TO_LOCATION FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG D WHERE D.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND D.BS_NO = #{BS_NO} AND D.STATUS <> 'D'

INSERT INTO KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVHD ( SELLER, INV_NO, BUYER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, INV_DATE, INV_TTL_AMT, INV_AMT, INV_TAX_AMT_1, INV_TAX_RATE_1, REMARK_INV ) SELECT 'KRKORE0001', #{INV_NO}, A.BUYER, 'C', '', '', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YY/MM/DD'), SUM(TRUNC((DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) * A.ITEM_QTY ))) + SUM(TRUNC((DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) * A.ITEM_QTY ) * 0.1 )), -- 총금액 SUM(TRUNC((DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) * A.ITEM_QTY ))), -- 공급사액 SUM(TRUNC((DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',A.AGENT_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE) * A.ITEM_QTY ) * 0.1 )), -- 부가세 0.1, '' FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO(+) AND B.BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND B.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND A.STATUS != 'D' GROUP BY A.BUYER

UPDATE KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG SET DELIVERY_FLAG = 'Y' , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER_CODE} AND BS_NO = #{BS_NO} AND DELIVERY_FLAG = 'N'
